projects.name: WolfTime - PWA
projects.short-description: A campus event web app that allows NC State students to discover, RSVP to, and manage events. The app supports secure account creation, login, and event tracking.
description: Worked in a team of 3 to build a full-stack Progressive Web App (PWA) for students to find, RSVP to, and manage campus events at NC State.
Users can create an account, log in, and track their events securely, all while using token-based authentication.
Built the frontend with React and Material UI to make it responsive and easy to use on any device.
Developed the backend with Node.js, Express, and MySQL to handle user data and events.
Used Docker to make development and deployment simple and reliable.

projects.name: CoffeeMaker - SWE Project
projects.short-description: Worked with a team to develop a web app for managing café operations, including menus, orders, and user roles. The app features secure login and tailored tools for customers, baristas, and managers.
description: Built a full-stack web app with a team of 5 to manage cafe operations like menus, orders, and tracking.
Implemented secure login with different user roles like customers, baristas, and managers, each with access to specific tools.
Developed the backend with Java and Spring Boot for handling logic, authentication, and the MySQL database.
Built a responsive frontend with React, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
Followed best practices using GitHub for version control and project management.

projects.name: 2D Game Engine
projects.short-description: Designed and built a custom multi-threaded 2D game engine optimized for platformers, featuring collision, physics, rendering, and input systems. Added multiplayer support through efficient client-server communication using integrated networking.
description: Designed and implemented a custom multi-threaded, component-based 2D game engine optimized for platformer-style games.
Developed core systems including entity-component architecture, collision, physics, rendering, and input handling using SDL2.
Integrated ZeroMQ to support efficient networking and client-server communication, enabling multiplayer capabilities.

projects.name: SimCLR Analysis
projects.short-description: Analyzed the SimCLR algorithm by training a self-supervised model and visualizing learned features with t-SNE. Explored how contrastive learning improves representation quality in unsupervised settings.
description: Conducted an in-depth analysis of the SimCLR algorithm by training a self-supervised learning model on image datasets.
Utilized t-SNE to visualize the high-dimensional feature representations learned at various training epochs.
Gained insights into representation learning and the effectiveness of contrastive learning in unsupervised settings.

projects.name: AI Projects
projects.short-description: Created AI projects exploring logic-based and heuristic problem-solving, including an inductive logic programming system and a strategic agent for Connect 4. Applied optimization techniques like hill climbing and simulated annealing to solve the linear assignment problem.
description: Developed a series of AI-focused projects using Java and Prolog, exploring both logic-based and heuristic problem-solving methods.
Built an inductive logic programming system to infer rules from structured examples.
Created an adversarial agent capable of making strategic decisions for the game Connect 4.
Applied optimization techniques like hill climbing and simulated annealing to solve the linear assignment problem, balancing efficiency with solution quality.
Demonstrated a strong grasp of AI concepts, including search algorithms, logical inference, and agent-based modeling.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.short-description: Designed a responsive portfolio website to showcase academic, technical, and volunteer experiences in a clean, single-page layout. Focused on user-friendly navigation and easy content updates using structured JSON.
description: Designed and developed a responsive portfolio website to showcase academic, technical, and volunteer experiences.
Built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with a focus on clean design and user-friendly navigation.
Organized project highlights and experience summaries into an accessible, single-page layout.
Utilized structured JSON content for easy updates and future scalability.

projects.name: Self Driving Car
projects.short-description: Developed a ROS 2-based autonomous driving system in Python and C for a physical vehicle, featuring real-time lane following, obstacle avoidance, and embedded low-latency control systems.
description: Developed a ROS 2-based autonomous driving system using Python and C, enabling real-time lane following, obstacle avoidance, and full navigation on a physical vehicle.
Engineered computer vision pipelines with OpenCV for lane detection and tracking, integrating camera and LiDAR data for robust real-time perception.
Designed and tuned PID controllers for steering and throttle control to improve vehicle stability and responsiveness.
Built embedded communication and control systems using C on Teensy and Arduino microcontrollers, implementing CAN messaging and sensor integration for reliable low-latency actuation.
Improved lane-following stability by approximately 25% through PID tuning and optimization of the OpenCV pipeline, achieving real-time performance at 30 FPS.

projects.name: Siemens Healthineers RAG Assistant
projects.short-description: Built and evaluated a modular RAG architecture to study how retrieval quality, chunking strategies, and prompt design affect LLM response accuracy and coherence.
description: Implemented a modular retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture to analyze the effects of retrieval quality, chunking strategies, and prompt engineering on LLM output accuracy.
Explored trade-offs between embedding granularity, retrieval recall, and response coherence in vector-based semantic search systems.
Built an end-to-end ingestion pipeline for loading, chunking, embedding, and indexing documents for semantic search workflows.
Used Python, LangChain, ChromaDB, and Gemini models to generate grounded, document-aware responses from large language models.
Conducted experimentation and evaluation on retrieval and generation pipelines to better understand performance and accuracy characteristics in enterprise AI systems.

projects.name: Automated Event Operations Dashboard (7PointScheduleCreator)
projects.short-description: Built an automated event operations dashboard that scrapes scheduling data, processes logistics, and visualizes daily workflows through an interactive web interface.
description: Developed an automated dashboard that scrapes event scheduling data and visualizes operational workflows in a locally hosted web interface.
Built a Playwright-based web scraping pipeline to authenticate, navigate dynamic pages, and extract event logistics data.
Implemented scheduling and deadline calculation logic using Pendulum to normalize inconsistent time formats.
Designed a responsive frontend with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript featuring timeline-based task visualization and interactive task tracking.
Added asynchronous data loading, auto-scrolling, current-time highlighting, and task completion controls to improve usability.
Created a lightweight Python HTTP server for simplified local deployment and automated browser launching.
Configured secure environment-based credential management and customizable filtering rules for schedule generation.
